warnings: Truss members are round steel pipes printed 'ø-100 mm. t = 4.5 mm.' etc.: designation kept as the printed 'ø' (schema 6a, family not seen before — keys d_mm/t_mm follow the printed order). The leader-tagged section of each truss goes in steel_section; a second printed size on the same truss goes in members[] with the part it points to.

T1: span 19.00 printed between supports with ~1.00 panels (22 panels incl. overhangs), mono-pitch depths printed panel by panel 1.91 ... 0.39; T2 depth ~1.80 (0.90 + 0.90), T3 depth ~0.69, both with ~1.10 panels between T1 trusses on grids 2-4 (5.50 bays).
